title: Coastal Dream
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Coastal Dream”, a luxury 7-bed, 5.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 20 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Game Room & Golf Cart for your exclusive enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Discover Coastal Dream, your premier Seagrove Beach vacation rental and ultimate 7-bedroom luxury 30A rental at 292 Williams Street, Santa Rosa Beach, Florida —a brand-new 2021 build spanning 5,068 square feet across three stories of coastal elegance. Nestled just one block from pristine Eastern Lake beach access in the heart of charming Seagrove Beach along Florida's coveted 30A corridor, this Gulf Coast beach house blends timeless Old Florida charm with modern sophistication. Sleeps up to 20 guests in plush, thoughtfully designed suites, making it the perfect Florida Gulf Coast vacation home for multigenerational family reunions, lively bachelorette getaways, or serene snowbird retreats. With Gulf views from every balcony, a heated private pool, and effortless beach adventures, Coastal Dream delivers unforgettable sun-soaked memories in one of the best beachfront homes on 30A without the crowds. Home Highlights for Your Seagrove Beach Getaway • Heated Private Pool & Summer Kitchen: Lounge poolside with a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, TV, and Sonos sound system—heat available seasonally for just $30/day (October 1–May 1). Ideal for “private pool vacation rentals” in Seagrove Beach. • Elevator: Seamless multi-level convenience for all ages and abilities. • Gulf-View Balconies Galore: Sip morning coffee or toast sunsets from expansive porches, including a third-floor Berlin Gardens Comfo Back Bar setup—perfect for Gulf view rentals on 30A. • Mobility Perks Included: Cruise in style with a complimentary 6-seater golf cart and 6 adult bikes; kayaks, paddleboards, and air pump ready for Eastern Lake explorations. • Ample Parking & Storage: Space for 4 vehicles, plus a garage for gear. • Beach Essentials: Direct path to soft sands and turquoise waters—no crossing 30A—plus complimentary beach chairs for your Santa Rosa Beach beach house stay. • Entertainment Hub: Third-floor game room with ping-pong table and plush seating; second-floor theater seating with PS5 console and controller and 75” smart tv. • Gourmet Chef's Kitchen: Open-concept heart of the home with high-end appliances, flowing into a massive dining tables for 10+ (indoor/outdoor options)—a chef's dream in this luxury beach house rental. Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps +20) in This 7-Bedroom 30A Rental Every bedroom is a private oasis with premium linens, smart TVs, and blackout shades for restful nights. All baths feature luxurious tile/glass showers; many with soaking tubs and double vanities—tailored for family vacation rentals on 30A or large group beach houses. • First Floor (Sleeps 2): o Primary Guest Suite—King bed + ensuite bath (double vanities, soaking tub, walk-in shower). o Half bath for added convenience. • Second Floor (Sleeps 14): o Primary Guest Suite—King bed + ensuite (double vanities, soaking tub, walk-in shower). o Family Guest Suite—King bed + Twin-over-Twin bunks + ensuite (double vanities, shower). o Family Guest Suite—King bed + Twin-over-Twin bunks + ensuite (single vanity, shower). o Bunk Room—Two Twin-over-Twin bunks + shared bath—great for sleeps 20 vacation rentals. • Third Floor (Sleeps 4): o King Guest Suite—King bed + shared bath (single vanity, shower). o Queen Guest Suite—Queen bed + shared bath (single vanity, shower). Why Coastal Dream is Your Top Seagrove Beach Vacation Rental Choice Imagine waking to the gentle Gulf breeze in this Florida beach house rental, just steps from uncrowded beaches where turquoise waves meet powdery white sand. Coastal Dream captures Seagrove Beach's laid-back allure—a peaceful enclave amid 30A's vibrant scene—while delivering upscale perks that make every moment magical. Built in 2021 with a fresh, trendy coastal vibe, this luxury Gulf Coast vacation home wraps you in colorful, fun interiors that feel as lively as a beachside festival. The open-concept main level invites effortless gatherings: whip up feasts in the chef's kitchen, dine al fresco by the pool, or unwind in multiple living lounges with smart TVs and cozy seating. Adventure awaits beyond your doorstep in this prime Santa Rosa Beach rental. Pedal bikes or hop in the golf cart to Seaside (5–10 minutes away) for boutique shopping, live music at The Red Bar, or sunset strolls. Paddleboard on Eastern Lake at dawn for SUP yoga, hike Deer Lake State Park (1 mile), or venture to WaterColor, Watersound, Grayton Beach, or Rosemary Beach for eclectic dining and nightlife—all without rental car hassles. For the ultimate chill, claim a balcony chaise for Gulf gazing, fire up the summer kitchen for rosé-fueled pool parties, or challenge the crew to PS5 marathons in the game room. More than a rental, Coastal Dream is a legacy property curated for connection and seclusion—ideal for bachelorette getaway rentals on 30A, family reunion homes in Florida, or extended snowbird stays. With elevator ease, generous space, and every detail polished for luxury—from high-thread-count sheets to Sonos audio system-synced tunes—it's the ultimate 7-bedroom beach house on 30A. Centrally positioned on 30A, enjoy proximity to world-class beaches, nature trails, trendy cafes, and hidden gems, all while retreating to your private paradise. Perfect for family reunions, long bachelorette weekends, or snowbird months.
